introduction: Utah Legal Services and Timpanogos Legal Center provide different civil legal-help routes. Ask the provider which service fits your case before assuming full representation.
description: Utah Legal Services and Timpanogos Legal Center provide different civil legal-help routes. Ask the provider which service fits your case before assuming full representation.

sections.who: Each organization screens its own cases. Timpanogos clinics assess income or an abuse-related qualifying situation.
sections.get: Legal information, brief advice, clinics or qualifying case assistance depending on provider and case.
sections.docs:
• Court notices and deadlines.
  • Relevant agreements and correspondence.
  • Income information requested during screening.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the relevant service

    Review Utah Legal Services topics and Timpanogos programs.

  2. Request screening

    Explain your location, issue and upcoming court date.

  3. Confirm the scope

    Ask whether the provider offers advice, documents or representation.
sections.after: Follow court notices while waiting and keep copies of documents given to intake.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using ULS services and interpretation, Timpanogos eligibility and service types. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Do all clinics prepare every type of filing?
Timpanogos describes its document clinic as certain family-law filings.
Can housing issues fit a clinic?
Timpanogos lists housing among legal-advice clinic topics.
Utah Legal Services advertises free interpreters; ask intake about your language.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
